claim: Aloo Mannu is the local message and wake layer for coding agents, routing asks, replies and FYIs through files and hooks with one ledger of open asks.
Python 3.9+ standard library only with zero external dependencies, built into a single aloomannu.pyz zipapp.
Built-in selftest verifies four adapter delivery paths on disk: claude, pi, cursor and file.
Zero network and zero model calls, with every delivered message body wrapped in an untrusted-data frame.
Append-only per-node JSONL ledgers track sent, delivered, acknowledged, dated, done and killed states under exclusive file locks.
Guided first-run setup verb that finds installed tools, previews hook diffs, saves backups and times a first message delivery.
Structured join and leave verbs for unbound agent sessions with approver checks, 24-hour rejection holds and preserved history.
Local web console bound to 127.0.0.1 with an in-memory fragment token, read-only thread and ledger views, and single-node compose.
Private beta: v0.1.0 in private use, packaged as a standard-library Python zipapp and marked Private :: Do Not Upload.
Launch target: Target: end of November 2026, on the founder's final yes.
